summary: Partial seat-discount not applied due to cost-center tag flip during rate-cache propagation
description:
Issue summary:
Customer BrightPath Health reports that their enterprise seat discount (~15%) was applied to most lines on the March 1 invoice but omitted for a subset of high-throughput microburst hours between 2026-02-27T22:14:00Z and 2026-02-27T22:26:00Z. The result is a surprise ~€3,200 charge on an otherwise expected bill.

Impact:
- Financial: unexpected charge of ~€3,200 on finalized invoice for dedicated account.
- Operational: Billing variance affects customer finance reconciliation and renewals discussion.

Environment:
- Dedicated deployment (reserved capacity) for BrightPath Health
- Region: eu-west (Frankfurt)
- Time window: ~2026-02-27T22:14:00Z to 2026-02-27T22:26:00Z

Expected behavior:
- Seat-based discount tag attached to account/cost-center should be applied to every postback for hosted and private fallbacks for the tenant.

Actual behavior:
- A small subset of postbacks for microburst calls were attributed to the default cost-center, which did not have the negotiated seat discount. The discrepancy appears correlated with a rate-selector cache refresh and a rapid cost-center tag rename propagated by a customer admin during the same window.

Steps to reproduce (observed):
1) Customer performed high-concurrency inference (multi-model batch) during maintenance window.
2) Customer owner updated billing cost-center label in Console UI at 2026-02-27T22:12:55Z.
3) Rate-selector cache flushed at 2026-02-27T22:13:40Z during a config rollout.
4) Postback replays from edge proxies between 22:14 and 22:26 were processed; ~4% of those were tagged with legacy/default cost-center.

Attachments / logs: see attached postback IDs and billing line items below.

Notes: Customer contacted support via email and flagged the finalized invoice (INV-2026-03-BH-078). They requested a provisional credit while we investigate.
steps_to_reproduce: Customer changed cost-center label in Console UI at 2026-02-27T22:12:55Z
Rate-selector cache flush occurred at 2026-02-27T22:13:40Z (deploy tag propagation)
Edge proxies replayed buffered postbacks between 2026-02-27T22:14:00Z and 2026-02-27T22:26:00Z
Reconciler accepted postbacks and assigned default cost-center for ~4% of calls
comments: 2026-03-10 | Aisha Khan (Support): Received complaint from BrightPath Finance — unexpected invoice line. Confirmed INV-2026-03-BH-078. Opened ticket and escalated to billing engineering. SLA flagged P1.
2026-03-10 | Liam O'Connor (Billing Eng): Acknowledged. Requested sample postbacks and uid mapping (received pb-8a3c2f, pb-8a3c9b). Asking SRE to surface rate-selector logs for 22:12-22:27.

2026-03-11 | Maria Lopez (SRE): Rate-selector logs attached to PR #482 show cache invalidation at 22:13:40 and a short window where rate_id lookup fell back to default for requests routed to rs-eu-02. Noting increased postback retransmits from edge-03 at 22:15-22:25.
2026-03-11 | BrightPath (Bob Healey): Thank you — finance needs a provisional credit ASAP. Happy to provide any additional audit logs from our side.

2026-03-12 | Liam O'Connor (Billing Eng): Applied provisional credit of €3,200 to account as a debit memo (REF-CR-SUP-136789). Will reconcile and post final adjustment after root-cause fix. Notifying customer of provisional credit.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis A: cost-center rename race + rate-cache invalidation allowed some postbacks to resolve with legacy/default rate_id before tenant metadata propagated.
Hypothesis B: edge proxy replayed buffered postbacks after rename; reconciler dedupe logic did not re-evaluate cost-center tags on replayed postbacks.
Correlation: 98% of affected postbacks map to rs-eu-02 and edge-03; timeline matches console change at 22:12:55 and cache flush at 22:13:40.
Checked reconciler version 1.12.4 — known behavior: reconciler uses cost-center mapping cached at initial postback acceptance; replays bypass some new-metadata fetch paths.
Temporary mitigation: block on-console cost-center renames during rate-cache flush windows is recommended until fix is released.
resolution: 2026-03-12 | Provisional credit of €3,200 applied (REF-CR-SUP-136789) and customer notified.

2026-03-12 | Billing engineering merged hotfix to reconciler that forces fresh tenant metadata lookup for replayed postbacks (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/reconciler/pull/239). Deployed to rs-eu-02 and edge-03, verified no further misattributions in canary window.

Follow-up actions: (1) Postmortem to be authored and linked; (2) Add gating in Console to warn/confirm cost-center renames when rate-selector cache invalidation is in flight; (3) Additional reconciler unit tests for replay path metadata refresh.
Customer follow-up: BrightPath Finance accepted provisional credit and requested final adjustment post-reconciliation. Scheduled billing reconciliation call for 2026-03-16.
